turns.customer: I changed my mind about order #1056. Can I return it?
turns.reply:
Because your order is still in processing and hasn't been delivered yet, a return can't be started at this point — returns can only begin once the package arrives.

If it doesn't fit or isn't right when it does come, you'll be able to use the return label in your account to send it back, and the warehouse will issue your refund once it arrives back.

Let me know if you have any other questions.
